bayts.text: I have placed my trust in the Lord of the Throne, Possessor of generosity and pardon, together with the Chosen One (Muḥammad); and God makes my purity everlasting.
I have placed my trust, together with the Chosen One (Al-Mukhtār, Muḥammad), in God alone; upon him the two salutations of peace of Him (Allah) who through him erased my idle words.
Through him He has kept me from evil, been with me in granting my wishes, and led to me sincerity, by which He erased my heedlessness.
I have entered as Servant (Khadīm) into my eulogy of Muḥammad — upon him God's blessing — as long as He guards my course for me.
I have entered as Servant (Khadīm) into my eulogy of my Means (Muḥammad); upon him the two salutations of peace of God, who exalts him and spreads his renown.
Every possessor of knowledge, striving and rank has fallen short of the Chosen One (Muḥammad), in his character that encompasses all sublimity.
Eminent, uniting (to God), arrived (at the goal), vast (in grace): he has Companions through whom God has spared me armed expedition.
Handsome of face, generous in giving, faithful executor, means to the best of Lords, whose remembrance has erased my idle diversion.
True to his word, generous, he promises and his promise has come to pass; through him the unjust has turned towards others than us, seized with fright.
Friend (of God), Prophet to the creatures, Messenger of Him (Allah) who through him has driven the oppressor and the assailant towards others than us.
My love goes to my Lord, to the one who came last (Al-Muqaffā, Muḥammad), to his company and to whoever loves them; and God has been with me in pardon.
I have placed my trust in the Everlasting (Allah), through whom I became His servant and Servant (Khadīm) of the best of creation, with constancy and purity.
I seek the good pleasure of Him (Allah) who guards my whole being at all times, for the Companions of him (Muḥammad) with whose love my heart is filled.
My God, be well pleased with the Companions of the Prophet, leading joy to them whenever the praiser recites my eulogy.
My beloved ones in the two abodes are the Companions, through whom my God has driven towards others than me whoever is not free (of evil).
God willed nothing but that he (Muḥammad) be master through them; they subdued the disbelievers, and all (the enemies) they struck down.
Lions against the enemies, lamps in the darkness; and each, valiant, severs the head of the disbeliever.
Lions: whenever a rash one sets upon them, he returns a coward, weeping, and his rashness is erased.
O Servant of the Chosen One (Al-Mukhtār, Muḥammad), do not forget his Companions: whoever forgets them, his eulogy is a faulty eulogy.
Abū Bakr aṣ-Ṣiddīq (the Truthful), man of sincerity and fidelity, companion of the Prophet, the Chosen One, in the cave: it bears witness to this.
Abū Ḥafṣ (ʿUmar) al-Fārūq (the Discerner), whose equal is rare: through him the religion of the Chosen One grew strong when it was being shaken.
Is there among the Companions one who resembles the son of ʿAffān (ʿUthmān), the man of modesty? His the light, then (again) the light (Dhū n-Nūrayn): how excellent the one who gave (him) a home!
The father of the two grandsons of the Chosen One (Al-Ḥasan and Al-Ḥusayn), who is the son of his uncle, ʿAlī: he rose high and was chosen; how excellent a fearless one!
O Companions of the Messenger of God, I am his Servant (Khadīm), who loves you in God; and God watches over (all).
The love of God — how excellent a Vigilant Guardian! — has held me back from swerving from what was chosen; and Truth is most worthy (to be followed).
I have cast away worthless things, as servant of my Lord alone, Servant of him (Muḥammad) whom tongues have wearied of grasping.
I have razed the edifice of falsehood with truth, praising the Incomparable one (Muḥammad), of a character before which every custom falls short.
I have resolved to persevere in remembrance and thanksgiving, as Servant of the best of creation: how excellent, handsome and adorned with grace!
Prophet, Messenger, the best of servants and master, Intimate Friend, Beloved, whose like is never seen.
Intimate confidant (of God), near, the one who remembers and gives thanks, bountiful, generous, doing good with noble deeds.
Pure, God-fearing, righteous and himself a reformer, Bearer of glad tidings for whoever submits to God in truth.
Illustrious, refined in conduct, modest, polished, a Warner to whoever proclaims disbelief and association.
Sincere counsellor without deceit, knowing and teaching, bountiful without reproach, of softening speech.
Noble, wondrous, tireless (in worship) and an ascetic: he is the one who enjoins (good) and forbids (evil), who perseveres in good.
Chief, watchful, answering, purified, the Messiah (Al-Masīḥ, a name of the Prophet), refuge; he is the Effacer (Al-Māḥī) and the benefactor.
Of noble lineage, of noble rank, rich in gifts, O Placed Foremost! He is "Mankind" (an-Nās) and the Balance: how excellent the one made firm!
A Prophet of immense and manifest rank: he is the Chosen (Al-Muṣṭafā), the Elect (Al-Mukhtār), he is the Designated.
His Prophethood was manifest before creation; his was the precedence when the forefather (Adam) was still kept in clay.
Valiant, glorious, bringing (to God) whoever turns to him; exalted, favoured, the one who enriches and who proclaims (the Truth).
My gain, my permanence and my triumph, without hardship, are made manifest in my being the Servant (Khadīm) of the Chosen One (Muḥammad).
His sincere counsel has appeared to me in secret and in the open; through him the All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān) has led to me a veil that guards like a fortress.
I have intended the good pleasure of the All-Merciful in my service to him (Muḥammad) through whom (God) has driven away from my path whoever does not submit.
By (the grace of) the Prophet, God has driven the envious towards others than us, and they have been driven towards others, away from the one who practises divination.
The One (Al-Wāḥid), the Subduer (Al-Qahhār), through him has repelled the enemies from me: one by one and two by two they turned their backs, then were made to yield.
Through him I have made fruitful a land whose harvests have become pure; upon him the two salutations of peace of the Best of Enrichers, He who establishes.
His purity has cleansed my whole being of idle words; and his Sunna, if my Lord wills, I shall make manifest.
I have kept myself pure in being servant of my Lord and Servant of him (Muḥammad); and through him the Giver of abode (Allah) has purified my life and my home.
I have resolved, for what has been chosen for me, to give thanks by serving the best of creation: how excellent the one who came last, the Designated!
